project.name: JAY Builders one-page website rebuild
project.purpose: Rebuild the existing UI to closely match the supplied prototype and remove content not represented in the approved layout.
project.implementation_instruction: Treat JAY_Builders.png as the master visual reference and each named section image as the detailed visual reference for that section.

image_archive.purpose: Contains the master prototype, individual section references and reusable SVG icons.

content_archive.purpose: Contains separate plain-text content files for every page section.

source_of_truth_priority: technical-specifications.json for behaviour, structure and responsive rules
individual section reference images for spacing, proportions and visual treatment

required_stack.constraint: Do not add a heavy UI component library that changes the visual language.

hero.image_treatment: full-bleed background image with a left-to-right dark gradient overlay
hero.cta_layout: two inline buttons on desktop, stacked or wrapped on small screens

desktop_lower_area.urgent_card_behaviour: sticky within its grid column only when viewport height permits

sections.layout: image gallery left, copy centre, testimonial right

mobile: Urgent assistance is not fixed or overlaid.
Project cards may use a horizontal snap carousel only if all content remains keyboard accessible.
tablet: Customer stories use two columns with the final card spanning or centred.
Project gallery uses two or three columns.
Lower area becomes one column before 992px.
desktop: Match the prototype's compact vertical rhythm.
Keep all main sections within the shared max-width container except full-width dark bands.

interaction.video_cards: open accessible modal or embedded player; thumbnails remain images until activated
interaction.project_cards: optional lightbox; before-and-after divider is visual only unless implemented as an accessible slider

form.success_state: inline confirmation with no full page reload where practical

requirements: Semantic heading hierarchy with one H1.
Alt text for meaningful images and empty alt for decorative images.
Form labels must not rely on placeholders.
Colour contrast of at least 4.5:1 for normal text.
Video controls and captions where videos are published.

image_rules: Convert production photography to AVIF or WebP.
Keep supplied PNGs as visual references, not necessarily final production assets.
Use responsive srcset and explicit width/height.
Do not lazy-load the hero's primary image.

seo.title: JAY Builders | Renovations, Extensions & Property Services
seo.meta_description: Trusted building, renovation, extension, maintenance and emergency property services in Reading and surrounding areas.

content_constraints.claims_note: Replace placeholder phone, company number, review-platform claims and testimonials with verified business details before production.

acceptance_criteria: Overall section order and proportions visibly match JAY_Builders.png.
No unapproved content or sections remain in the UI.
Every section uses its matching text file and reference image.
Desktop, tablet and mobile layouts have no overlap or horizontal scrolling.
Urgent assistance card does not obscure form or footer.
All CTA buttons have working targets.
Form validation and file restrictions work.
Build passes accessibility and performance checks.
Visual regression screenshots are produced at 375px, 768px, 1440px widths.

suggested_file_structure.src/content: unzip content.zip or convert each file into data constants
